title: QBSC/26/044 - Removal and Disposal of Beach Debris - Wunjunga
description:
Burdekin Shire Council invites quotations from suitably qualified respondents for the removal and disposal of beach debris to the north of the Wunjunga township, as described in more detail in Part 5 – Scope and in Appendix 1. 

Council requires all work to be completed by 31 November 2026.
